verified_facts.text: Le Negresco has stood on the Promenade des Anglais in Nice since 1913.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1913, Le Negresco has graced the legendary Promenade des Anglais

verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: overlooking the endless blue of the Mediterranean

verified_facts.text: Le Negresco is independent.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dazzling icon, free-spirited and independent

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites combine period furnishings with modern amenities and look out over the Baie des Anges or the Masséna garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Combining period furnishings and modern amenities, our 5-star accommodation in Nice offers breathtaking views of the Baie des Anges or the Masséna garden.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are furnished with pieces ranging from antiques to contemporary creations, each inspired by distant lands and remarkable periods of history.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegantly appointed with exceptional furnishings, from antiques to contemporary creations, each of the 102 rooms and 28 suites draws inspiration from distant lands and the most remarkable periods of history.

verified_facts.text: The Signature Collection includes named suites such as the Marie-Antoinette Suite and the Montserrat Caballe Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt:

verified_facts.text: La Rotonde is a contemporary brasserie.
verified_facts.excerpt: A contemporary brasserie and a beloved institution in Nice

verified_facts.text: Le 1913 is the hotel's historic bar, evoking English clubs, with amber-toned panelling, artworks and bespoke cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its amber-toned panelling, artworks, and bespoke cocktails

verified_facts.text: Le Versailles is a champagne bar with a terrace; on summer evenings it offers cocktails, sharing plates and live music.
verified_facts.excerpt: On summer evenings, Le Versailles becomes a celebration of life’s pleasures: cocktails, sharing plates, and live music.

verified_facts.text: N La Plage, the hotel's beach club, is open daily from May to September.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach open daily from May to September

verified_facts.text: The beach club garden was created by floral and landscape designer Herve Frezal, a Meilleur Ouvrier de France, with native Mediterranean plants such as jasmine, fig and palm.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floral and landscape designer Hervé Frezal, a Meilleur Ouvrier de France (Best Craftsman of France), has successfully created a setting of exquisite harmony.

verified_facts.text: N La Plage serves Kids Boxes for young guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: a selection of “Kids Boxes” beloved by young connoisseurs

verified_facts.text: N Le Spa uses art as its guiding theme.
verified_facts.excerpt: The red thread and guiding spirit of the Spa is art, explored through three pillars:

verified_facts.text: The spa pool is bathed in natural light and has underwater music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathed in natural light, this pool offers a truly immersive experience, complete with underwater music

verified_facts.text: The spa's wet area has saunas, hammams and sensory showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Saunas, hammams, and sensory showers offer a sanctuary of calm and relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers immersive yoga sessions where digital art merges with sound and movement.
verified_facts.excerpt: A wholly new yoga experience, where digital art merges with sound and movement

verified_facts.text: The spa's Concept Store has a laboratory that creates a bespoke serum on the spot.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dedicated laboratory for the on-the-spot creation of a bespoke serum

verified_facts.text: L'Ecrin is a private spa suite suited to couples or friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: ideal for shared moments, as a couple or among friends

verified_facts.text: Fitness sessions with expert coaches can be held indoors or outside facing the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each session may be enjoyed indoors or outside, facing the sea.

verified_facts.text: Event venues include the Salon Royal, the Salon Massena, the Salon Louis XVI and the Baie des Anges Salon.
